The '''Alcove of Ruin''' was an alcove in the cliffs along the eastern edge of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was infected by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] after one of the [[Seeds of Rage]] was buried there.
